sentences.text: 1. This is applicants first application under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail, as they are apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.493/2023 registered at Police Station Kurawar, District Rajgarh (MP) for offence punishable under Section 498-A, 306, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Allegations against the applicants is of abetting suicide of the deceased Mamta who committed suicide by hanging on 21/08/2023.

3. Counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicant No.1 happens to be 73 year old mother-in-law of the deceased, whereas applicant No.2 is sister-in-law (Jethani) and applicant No.3 is sister-in-law (Nanand) of the deceased and only omnibus allegations have been leveled against them.

It is submitted that the deceased has not left any suicide note and the statements have been recorded by the brother of the deceased Ramswaroop on 19/09/2023 and 25/01/2024 and it is only in the subsequent statement that he has alleged harassment at the instance of the present applicants.

Counsel has submitted that 2 MCRC-28002-2024 all the applicants are women and there is apprehension that they would ran away from the course of justice and initially a case under Section 376 of IPC was registered and the allegation of rape was made against the brother-in-law of the deceased, however, the aforesaid allegation was found to be false and thus, a case under Section 498-A, 306 and 34 of IPC has been alleged against the applicants.
It is also submitted that there are no criminal antecedents of the applicants and no purpose would be served to arrest them at this stage.
4. Counsel for the respondent /
State , on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that no case for anticipatory bail is made out.

sentences.text: 5. On due consideration of the rival submissions and perusal of the case diary and the fact that omnibus allegations have been leveled against the applicants who are family members of the husband of the deceased.
In view of the same, under the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the custodial interrogation of the applicants is not necessary in the present case.
In view of the same, applicants have made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.
6. Accordingly, this application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event o f arrest, applicants shall be released on bail, upon their executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) each and furnishing one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
7.
The applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
They shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
